items.label: LOADER
items.why: AD bootstrap; VICE can instead autostart the next directory entry.

items.label: DOUBLE DRAGON-N
items.why: The startup routine unpacks from a PRG loaded at $0801. The native title hand-over at $1A60 matches the software run of the unpacker, including the resident engine, AD loader and AD title.

items.label: IN
items.why: AD uses the same IN scene at $1A60 with 26 changed credit cells; title-ad carries the changed address span, with title-to as its shared base.

items.label: ED
items.why: The full disk payload matches both snapshots stopped at the ending entry at $B500. In the play snapshot, 878 bytes are different after the ending fills its display matrix and updates its sprite pointers and animation counters.

items.label: L1
items.why: The original file is the shared level overlay. Both disks load it through the level transition. The listing excludes 2048 bytes of zero-filled screen buffers that gameplay replaces.
